items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: The interviewer addresses the interviewee as 'Mr. Brian', but the interviewee never mentions or interacts with a person named 'Mr. Brian' in the provided text.

ctx.x: Federal Street, yes. I don't recognize. Yeah, Federal Street. That's the Prince's Theatre. Oh, yes. Here it tells on the front.
Prince's Family Theatre, Youngstown, Ohio. Now, can you tell me when you first met your wife, Mr. Brian? Oh, yes. It was in

the year of... 19... 1908. 1909. Were you in the entertainment field? Oh, yes. I started out with this little company that she joined later in 1908, but I didn't actually meet her until 1909. And I took the company out with all men, all boys. Of course, I was not a boy myself. Yes, sir. But I somehow, I had a... No show people in my family, but I just had that inclination to be a showman. And I got together these boys and started out with a little menstrual style show, which later became a kind of a presentation…
